## Persisted state

<!-- agent-engineering:judgment:schema-state:start -->
**This repository holds no database, no migrations and no persistent application state.** The sensor found zero schema files, and that is correct rather than a detection gap — INFERRED from the absence of any ORM, driver or SQL dependency in a manifest that declares no dependencies at all, OBSERVED `package.json:1`.

What the kit persists lives **inside the target project**, and those shapes are what a Data-focused pass needs.

| Store | Path (in the target project) | Committed | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Run ledger | `.dev/work/<id>/run.json` | **yes** | control metadata only: team, skip set, approval, per-role severity, accepted gaps, `brief_sha`. A clone that lacks it can read what was decided but cannot check that the gates fired |
| Approved brief | `.dev/work/<id>/brief.md` | **yes** | the contract the release audit compares the delivered change against |
| Expert results | `.dev/work/<id>/results/<role>.md` | no | transcripts and raw evidence; may carry sensitive material |
| Run artifact | `.dev/runs/<id>.md` | yes | the only channel between stages |
| Sensor dump | `.dev/context/analysis.json` | no | regenerated wholesale |
| Host + enforce markers | `.dev/context/host.json`, `enforce.json` | yes / no | `host.json` is identical for every clone; `enforce.json` attests to one session |
| Knowledge and rules | `.dev/knowledge/`, `.dev/rules/` | yes | the deliverable |

The ignore rules are at OBSERVED `skills/ae-surveyor/assets/gitignore.fragment:10`. The boundary used to be drawn around the `work/` directory rather than around sensitivity, which put `run.json` on the wrong side.

Evidence for the record shape: constructed at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:560`; legal phase transitions at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:18`; the brief digest recorded at approval at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:340`.

**The migration path is "no migration".** `run.json` carries a `schema` field and a `contract` version, but nothing reads either to upgrade an older record — INFERRED: no branch in `forge.mjs` switches on `run.schema` beyond rejecting a foreign one at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:526`. Runs are short-lived, so this is reasonable; it becomes a defect the first time a `contract v2` record is resumed by a later kit.

**`.dev/context/enforce.json`** is written only by the `SessionStart` hook, at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/guard.mjs:66`, and read by `enforceTier` at OBSERVED `skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs:295`. It is evidence that the enforcement tier is live in this session, not a claim that it should be. It is deliberately not created in an unsurveyed project.

**The managed-block convention is the durability mechanism.** `writeManaged` preserves human text outside the markers, preserves completed judgment slots when the input snapshot is unchanged, and demotes them to one bounded "previous synthesis — STALE" copy when the inputs move. OBSERVED `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/artifact-support.mjs:38`. It refuses to write against a half-open block, OBSERVED `skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/artifact-support.mjs:52`.

**UNKNOWN — generator provenance is still not stored.** `stamp` records the analysis snapshot, input sha, commit and dirty flag, never the kit version that rendered the block.
